in_hebrew.name: תירצה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the Hebrew word תרצה (tirzah), which means 'joy' or 'gladness'. In the Bible, the name Tirzah is mentioned as one of the names of a daughter of Zibiah and the mother of King Jeroboam II of Israel (2 Kings 14:21).

in_greek.name: Θερσίδα
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the Greek word θερσίδα (therisda), which means 'to yield' or 'to flow'. In Greek mythology, Therisda was the name of a nymph who was the goddess of the river Tigris.

in_latin.name: Tertia
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the Latin word ter, meaning 'third'. In the Roman Empire, Tertia was a common name for girls born as the third child in a family.
